## File: `./tests/test_notifications/test_dispatcher.py`

```python
import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from notifications.base import NotificationEvent, NotificationPriority
from notifications.dispatcher import NotificationDispatcher, get_dispatcher, notify

def test_dispatch_priority_filtering():
    mock_notifier = MagicMock()
    mock_notifier.name = "Mock"
    mock_notifier.is_configured.return_value = True
    
    dispatcher = NotificationDispatcher([mock_notifier])
    dispatcher.set_min_priority(NotificationPriority.WARNING)
    
    # Should be filtered out
    event_info = NotificationEvent("INFO", "Title", "Msg", NotificationPriority.INFO)
    dispatcher.dispatch(event_info)
    mock_notifier.send.assert_not_called()
    
    # Should pass
    event_warning = NotificationEvent("WARN", "Title", "Msg", NotificationPriority.WARNING)
    dispatcher.dispatch(event_warning)
    mock_notifier.send.assert_called_once_with(event_warning)

def test_dispatch_disabled():
    mock_notifier = MagicMock()
    mock_notifier.name = "Mock"
    mock_notifier.is_configured.return_value = True
    
    dispatcher = NotificationDispatcher([mock_notifier])
    dispatcher.disable("Mock")
    
    event = NotificationEvent("INFO", "Title", "Msg", NotificationPriority.INFO)
    dispatcher.dispatch(event)
    mock_notifier.send.assert_not_called()
    
    dispatcher.enable("Mock")
    dispatcher.dispatch(event)
    mock_notifier.send.assert_called_once_with(event)

@patch("notifications.dispatcher.threading.Thread")
def test_dispatch_async(mock_thread):
    dispatcher = NotificationDispatcher([])
    event = NotificationEvent("INFO", "Title", "Msg", NotificationPriority.INFO)
    dispatcher.dispatch_async(event)
    mock_thread.assert_called_once()
    mock_thread.return_value.start.assert_called_once()

@patch("notifications.dispatcher.NotificationDispatcher.dispatch_async")
def test_notify_global(mock_dispatch):
    notify("TEST", "Title", "Msg", symbol="RELIANCE")
    mock_dispatch.assert_called_once()
    event = mock_dispatch.call_args[0][0]
    assert event.event_type == "TEST"
    assert event.title == "Title"
    assert event.symbol == "RELIANCE"
```

```python
import pytest

from notifications.base import NotificationEvent, NotificationPriority

@pytest.fixture
def mock_env():

        yield

def test_telegram_is_configured(mock_env):

def test_telegram_not_configured():

        notifier = TelegramNotifier()
        assert not notifier.is_configured()

def test_telegram_format_message(mock_env):
    notifier = TelegramNotifier()
    event = NotificationEvent(
        event_type="TRADE_ENTRY",
        title="Test Trade",
        message="Message content",
        priority=NotificationPriority.INFO,
        symbol="RELIANCE"
    )
    
    formatted = notifier._format_message(event)
    assert "📈" in formatted
    assert "<b>Test Trade</b>" in formatted
    assert "Message content" in formatted
    assert "RELIANCE" in formatted

@patch("notifications.telegram.threading.Thread")
def test_telegram_send(mock_thread, mock_env):
    notifier = TelegramNotifier()
    event = NotificationEvent(
        event_type="INFO",
        title="Title",
        message="Message",
        priority=NotificationPriority.INFO
    )
    
    result = notifier.send(event)
    assert result is True
    mock_thread.assert_called_once()
```

```python
import pytest
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from scheduler.job_store import JobStore, ScheduledJob

@pytest.fixture
def temp_db(tmp_path):
    db_path = tmp_path / "jobs.db"
    return JobStore(db_path)

def test_job_store_save_load(temp_db):
    job = ScheduledJob(
        job_id="test_1",
        name="Test Job",
        job_type="eod_screener",
        cron_expr="35 15 * * 1-5",
        params={"strategy": "EMA_CROSS"}
    )
    temp_db.save(job)
    
    jobs = temp_db.load_all()
    assert len(jobs) == 1
    assert jobs[0].job_id == "test_1"
    assert jobs[0].params["strategy"] == "EMA_CROSS"

def test_job_store_delete(temp_db):
    job = ScheduledJob("t1", "T", "type", "* * * * *")
    temp_db.save(job)
    temp_db.delete("t1")
    jobs = temp_db.load_all()
    assert len(jobs) == 0

def test_job_store_update_last_run(temp_db):
    job = ScheduledJob("t1", "T", "type", "* * * * *")
    temp_db.save(job)
    
    now = datetime.now()
    temp_db.update_last_run("t1", now, "SUCCESS")
    
    jobs = temp_db.load_all()
    assert jobs[0].last_status == "SUCCESS"
    assert jobs[0].last_run is not None
```

```python
import pytest
from datetime import datetime
from scheduler.job_store import JobStore
from scheduler.runner import AlgoDeskScheduler

def test_algo_desk_scheduler(tmp_path):
    job_store = JobStore(tmp_path / "jobs.db")
    scheduler = AlgoDeskScheduler(job_store)
    
    mock_func_called = False
    def mock_job_func(**kwargs):
        nonlocal mock_func_called
        mock_func_called = True
        
    scheduler.register_job_func("mock_type", mock_job_func)
    scheduler.start()
    
    job_id = scheduler.add_job("j1", "J1", "mock_type", "35 15 * * 1-5")
    assert job_id == "j1"
    
    jobs = scheduler.list_jobs()
    assert len(jobs) == 1
    
    scheduler.run_now("j1")
    assert mock_func_called is True
    
    scheduler.pause_job("j1")
    jobs = scheduler.list_jobs()
    assert jobs[0].enabled is False
    
    scheduler.resume_job("j1")
    jobs = scheduler.list_jobs()
    assert jobs[0].enabled is True
    
    scheduler.remove_job("j1")
    assert len(scheduler.list_jobs()) == 0
    
    scheduler.stop()
```
